text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I take cuteness to the extreme! ☆ I
mean,
cuteness is like happiness, right?
It's a shiny,
sparkly feeling that tugs at
your heartstrings!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Hey, Big Brother... have I got your
heart
racing?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Hey, Big Sister... have I got your
heart
racing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
